strokes.text: Manages one Color Correction filter with typed attributes for hue and opacity.
It is the typed form of @resources/filter for the `color_filter_v2` kind and follows the same lifecycle.
Import by collection name, parent UUID, parent name and filter name, separated by pipe characters:

glazes.name: Name of the filter as shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.opacity: Opacity of the parent, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).
